history.rating_rationale: Priced right at the $1,522 median (no discount), with a sub-baseline 2.61% resale-only CAGR over an adequate 57 txns. No standout catalyst to justify paying median for sub-baseline appreciation.

history.summary: Freehold 1BR near Kovan MRT asking $1,522 psf, below the verified ~$1,942 psf project average — but that gap is mostly the size band (1BRs price differently from the large units that set the average), the cohort is thin (6 txns), and a 624 sqft 1BR in D19 OCR offers steady but modest investment upside.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified recent Tembusu transactions average ~$1,942 psf overall, but 1BR units carry an average listing psf of ~$1,670 (474-646 sqft), and comparable ~474 sqft units list at $897k-$935k. Against that, $950k for a larger 624 sqft 1BR ($1,522 psf) is reasonable-to-slightly-below the 1BR sub-market — not the ~23% bargain the project-pooled -23.3% vs-cohort suggests (cohort only 6 txns, a thin-data caution per v3.4). Genuine positives: freehold (a value floor, though not a forward edge), Kovan NEL MRT ~5-8 min walk, well-regarded build quality. Negatives: D19 OCR with no new dated catalyst, and a small 1BR has muted appreciation (2.61% trailing) and competes in a crowded rental segment. Fairly priced freehold unit with a sound location but no decisive edge — Neutral.
